$comment: Declared composition/verifier/runtime expectations for the uvd suite. Schema-level accept/reject cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (valid fixtures and fixtures/invalid/*), run with --schemas <ajv 2020 module url>. Most expectations below are NOW EXECUTABLE in the uvd-resolution suite (tools/uv-composition.mjs); only container-hashing and real-corpus admission stay declared.

vectors.note: effective value = nearest setting layer, else nearest ancestor; provenance names layer and document. Verified against Modkit SC2 value chains at real-corpus admission
a parent cycle is a typed refusal naming the cycle
a field the kind-schema does not declare is refused by name; vendor extensions live in namespaced kinds
an overlay removing a required field is refused: a mod reshapes values, not the shape
promotion to registered requires an SC2 catalog slice and a Warzone table slice converted, reopened losslessly and matched against Modkit resolved values
